name: Mayan Calendar
overview: The Mayan Calendar, while a complex system devised by an ancient culture to mark time, contrasts sharply with the biblical teaching that no one knows the exact day or hour of the end times, as Jesus declared that only the Father knows when these events will occur (Matthew 24:36). Scripture emphasizes the importance of proclaiming the gospel to all nations before the end comes (Matthew 24:14), highlighting God's sovereign control over history rather than human-made calendars. The prophetic visions recorded by Isaiah and Daniel remind believers that God’s timing governs the rise and fall of kingdoms (Isaiah 1:1; Daniel 9:1), underscoring that true understanding of time and destiny is found in God’s revelation, not in human systems like the Mayan Calendar.
